gloss: twice, two times; (with negative) never again

definitions.explanation: An action or event occurring two times.
Used with と and a negative verb to mean 'never again' - emphasizes a strong resolve not to repeat something.

examples.japanese: {二度|にど}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{行|い}かない→行く：00119_iku⟧。

examples.english: I swear I'll never tell a lie again.

notes:
{二度|にど} means "twice" or "two times." It can also express "never again" in a specific grammatical pattern.

KEY PATTERN:
{二度|にど}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ + negative verb = never again. This expresses strong resolve or emotional emphasis:
- {二度|にど}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{行|い}かない→行く：00119_iku⟧: I'll never go again
- {二度|にど}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{会|あ}いたくない→会う：00482_au⟧: I never want to see them again
- {二度|にど}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}さない→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧: I'll never repeat this

PROVERB:
{二度|にど}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三度|さんど}→三度：15154_sando⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: What happens twice will happen a third time (similar to "things come in threes").

RELATED COUNTING WORDS:
- ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧: once
- ⟦{三度|さんど}→三度：15154_sando⟧: three times
- ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧: how many times
- ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: many times, repeatedly
